faq.q: How does local image cropping work?
faq.a: CoolTools renders a draggable boundary frame overlay. The selected boundaries are mapped to natural source dimensions and painted onto Canvas for a lossless cut.

faq.q: Is the original image quality preserved?
faq.a: Yes. We scale your screen crop frame to the natural pixel boundaries of the file, meaning no pixel compression or quality degradation is introduced.
